title: I Tried Getting a Heat Pump… Here’s What Actually Happened
summary: A UK solar channel explains how heat pumps work, pairs them with solar, batteries and smart tariffs, and recounts a stalled install after conflicting heat loss surveys.

verdicts.note: Heating load moves from the gas or oil bill to the electricity bill, so winter electricity bills rise even when total energy cost falls.
Annual savings can hide more month-to-month variation, with bills rising in winter months and falling in summer.
Mass Save: heat pumps 'will likely increase your electric usage', which many customers offset by cutting oil or propane; the page does not say how much winter electric bills rise.
Flex-fuel homes went from 2-3% of heating site energy as electricity in furnace-only mode to 48-69% with the ccASHP, moving most of the heating bill onto electricity.
UK households' electricity use rose 61% (3,080 kWh/yr) after a heat pump, concentrated in winter at over 200 kWh/week and near zero from April to October.
